name: Tunnel
description: The camera flies down a tunnel lined with the first clip toward the second, which opens at the far end and grows to fill the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: speed
params.description: How far and fast the camera flies

params.name: twist
params.description: How much the walls spiral as they rush by
